description: This file contains methods for managing schema migration tables in a database, including checking schema format, migrating old schemas, and handling embedded migration files.

classes.name: SQLStore
classes.description: Struct representing the SQL storage layer, with methods for schema migration management.

methods.name: EnsureSchemaMigrationFormat
methods.description: Checks and migrates the schema migration table to the correct format if needed.

methods.name: getEmbeddedMigrations
methods.description: Retrieves embedded migration files from the assets directory.

methods.name: filterMigrations
methods.description: Filters migrations based on direction and legacy schema version.

methods.name: isSchemaMigrationNeeded
methods.description: Determines if schema migration is required by inspecting the schema_migrations table.

methods.name: isSchemaMigrationNeededSQLite
methods.description: Checks for the presence of the 'name' column in SQLite schema_migrations table.

methods.name: getLegacySchemaVersion
methods.description: Fetches the current legacy schema version from the database.

methods.name: createTempSchemaTable
methods.description: Creates a temporary schema migration table.

methods.name: populateTempSchemaTable
methods.description: Populates the temporary schema table with migration data.

methods.name: useNewSchemaTable
methods.description: Replaces the old schema table with the new one by renaming tables.

methods.name: deleteOldSchemaMigrationTable
methods.description: Deletes the old schema migration table.
